skills.name: Composite - Probe for a signal
skills.description: Use a probe to detect a signal from a measurement tool or device

steps.activity: Position the probe near the signal_source
Measure the signal from the probe
Observe the measured signal and compare it to the observed_signal
steps.category: Listen to or observe instructions or signals

examples: Use an outlet tester to confirm that a receptacle is powered
Use a magnetic stud finder to locate a ceiling stud
